name: Navaornis
sum: Enantiornithean from the Late Cretaceous Adamantina Formation of Brazil with a well-preserved, bird-like skull.
holotype: A well-preserved skull and skeleton (number in Chiappe et al. 2024).
material: The holotype and a referred basicranium described in 2022.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Chiappe et al. 2024
